dependencyContract.summary: Canonical rolling-to-FORGE dependency order for operator surfaces and preflight messaging.
dependencyContract.healthyRunRule: A healthy run requires each blocking stage to complete in order; success in a later stage does not excuse stale or skipped prerequisites.
dependencyContract.validationRule: Do not validate projections, dashboard readers, or downstream materializers until rolling_player_game_metrics, projection ingest, relationship materialization, and projection-derived tables are all fresh for the intended date window.
falseHealthySignals: A successful rolling recompute does not imply projection ingest or derived tables are current.
A successful ingest run does not imply rolling_player_game_metrics or contextual builders are fresh.
A successful downstream accuracy refresh does not imply projection_execution used healthy upstream inputs.

currentStage.label: Projection Input Ingest
currentStage.healthyRunRequirement: PBP and shift inputs must be ingested before projection-derived tables are rebuilt for the same window.

prerequisiteStages.label: Core Entity Freshness
prerequisiteStages.healthyRunRequirement: Games, teams, players, and rosters must refresh before any downstream freshness check is meaningful.

downstreamStages.label: Projection Relationship Build
downstreamStages.healthyRunRequirement: The exact relationship-owned shift scope must complete for the current input generation before projection-derived output can be published.
